nodes.author: HafsahD19
nodes.text: HMPV is a respiratory virus causing flu-like symptoms such as cough, fever & shortness of breath. It primarily affects vulnerable groups like children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. There is no specific vaccine, and treatment focuses on symptom management. 2/4

nodes.author: HafsahD19
nodes.text: HMPV can lead to more serious illnesses like bronchitis and pneumonia among elderly people, very young children, and people who are immunocompromised. 3/4

nodes.author: kavinda_4578123
nodes.text: We are on the brink of another pandemic because of China. The global community needs to force China to be transparent with the rest of the world and share relevant data to prevent #ChinaVirus from spreading. 4/4
